working_on.feature: EVCS Telemetry Protocol Migration & 24h Occupancy History Restoration
working_on.task: Phase 03: Coordinator Pipeline, 24h Stats Calculation & End-to-End Regression Verification
working_on.notes: 100% unit tests passing (8/8 in StationDetailTelemetryAnd24hHistoryIntegrationTest). Entire plan (Phases 01, 02, 03) completed successfully.

recent_changes.description: Implemented Phase 03: Coordinator Pipeline, 24h Stats Calculation & End-to-End Regression Verification. Modernized StationDetailCoordinator to forward chargingKw and uToken to telemetryRepository.sendTelemetryUpdate, set statsTimeoutMs default to 3000ms with bounded withTimeoutOrNull execution, implemented graceful null degradation on network failure, timeout, or empty matrix, verified UI stats grid mapping, and authored comprehensive single integration test file StationDetailTelemetryAnd24hHistoryIntegrationTest covering all 8 regression scenarios.

Implemented Phase 02: Network Data Source & Repository Telemetry Protocol Migration. Configured Content-Type text/plain on POST /update with embedded t, a, b, p, u tokens, implemented sendBatchTelemetryUpdate, added NonCancellable sync protection, implemented REST GET /history 24h time-series point retrieval adhering to RFC 6265bis Host-only cookie isolation, and updated EvcsTelemetryRepository with backward-compatible overloads and snapshot uToken retention.

errors_encountered.error: ComparisonFailure in JSON formatting due to joinToString default separator ', ' inserting space
errors_encountered.solution: Explicitly specify separator = ',' in joinToString to produce compact JSON matching browser curl capture

errors_encountered.error: MockWebServer queue response ordering conflict between concurrent fire-and-forget ping and sequential 24h history fetch
errors_encountered.solution: Use path-based okhttp3.mockwebserver.Dispatcher rather than sequential enqueue to eliminate queue race conditions

decisions_made.decision: Forward chargingKw and uToken from telemetry to telemetryRepository.sendTelemetryUpdate in StationDetailCoordinator
decisions_made.reason: Ensures the backend receives active per-tier charging distribution and hardware station security token on each inspection

decisions_made.decision: Default statsTimeoutMs to 3000ms with bounded withTimeoutOrNull in StationDetailCoordinator
decisions_made.reason: Prevents slow or stalling mobile networks from blocking background coroutines while guaranteeing instantaneous Stage 1 port display

decisions_made.decision: Degrade to stats24h = null and isLoadingStats = false on timeout, 500 error, or empty points
decisions_made.reason: Allows station detail UI to render fallback '-' placeholders gracefully without crashing or clearing Stage 1 port availability

decisions_made.decision: Use Content-Type: text/plain for POST /update and embed apiToken 't', stationId 'a', totalBusy 'b', power breakdown 'p', and integrityToken 'u' in request body without x-t header
decisions_made.reason: Aligns with EVCS backend real-world HTTP traffic capture and eliminates rejected requests

decisions_made.decision: Wrap sendTelemetryUpdate and sendBatchTelemetryUpdate in withContext(ioDispatcher + NonCancellable)
decisions_made.reason: Guarantees fire-and-forget telemetry synchronization completes reliably without socket abortion when user dismisses the station detail screen

decisions_made.decision: Do not transmit __Host-tp cookie to www2.evcs.vn/history
decisions_made.reason: Complies with RFC 6265bis Host-only cookie isolation for evcs.vn; www2 endpoints authenticate solely via URL query parameters ?sid=...&t=...

decisions_made.decision: Retain 3-parameter overload sendTelemetryUpdate(stationId, apiToken, totalBusy) delegating to 5-parameter overload
decisions_made.reason: Maintains 100% binary and source backward compatibility across existing test fakes (FakeEvcsTelemetryRepository) and legacy callers
